source_file: Berlin 2026 edition for next app devCon 2026 (flutterCon Berlin), sources listed on the page
question: Q1: Who Is Hiring, Looking, or Worried?

sections.prompt: Raise your hand if you hire developers or have a say in who gets hired.
sections.hint: Bitkom, Sep 2026: 79,000 unfilled IT jobs in Germany, down from 149,000 in 2023. Ask hirers what they look for now, beyond budget.
no_hands: What do you think hiring managers look for first in a Flutter candidate today?
Hiring tomorrow on a small budget: would you take a junior or a senior?
For the seniors: would what got you your last job still work today?
hands_up: What has changed in how you hire since last year?
How do you judge a candidate when a portfolio can be generated in an afternoon?
What did you stop asking for in interviews this year?
follow_ups: What is the fastest way for someone in this room to stand out to you?

sections.prompt: Raise your hand if you are looking for a Flutter job or project right now.
sections.hint: Indeed job postings index, Sep 2026: German software-dev postings at a record low, about half their Feb 2020 level. Let seekers speak before anyone gives advice.
no_hands: What would make you start looking?
How do you keep an eye on the market while you are not looking?
For hirers: what should people who are not looking still keep doing?
hands_up: Permanent role or freelance project: which are you looking for?
What gets a reply right now: applications, referrals, open source, or community?
How has AI changed the search itself, from screening to take-home tasks?
follow_ups: Which advice from the internet turned out to be wrong for your search?
What support from this community would actually help this month?

sections.prompt: Raise your hand if this year has made you worry about your own career.
sections.hint: Stack Overflow 2025: 64% of developers say AI is no threat to their job, down from 68% a year earlier. Eyes closed; count hands for the closer.
no_hands: What gives you confidence: your skills, your network, your savings, or your employer?
Is there anything you are quietly watching even though you are not worried?
For the seniors: what did an earlier downturn teach you that applies now?
hands_up: What triggered it: fewer job ads, AI demos, the news, or something you keep private?
Is it about Flutter, about mobile, or about software careers in general?
What have you actually done about it so far?
follow_ups: Which part of the worry is within your control?
Who do you talk to about it?

wrap_up: Based on the hands in this room, how does the market feel where you live, in one word?
What is one concrete signal a job seeker here should watch this autumn?
